name: Inktrons #0132
description: Built for the opening bell. Inktrons #0132 is an Uncommon Quadwall Vector, a four-screen monitor wall with a trading console, finished in Vintage Brass. Its screens stream GOOGL (Alphabet) with a climbing auction bid racing a countdown to SOLD alongside candle chart, heatmap, line + volume, worked by sliding faders and a push button. It comes with a siren on top, a paper stack at its side and a speaker tower in the corner. Set on a Neon Edge platform against scrolling trading code. ERC404 on Ink, one of 180.
